tagGDX2Class09SkillDescription03A: Oathkeepers are the zealous enforcers of celestial judgment. By their will, heathenous foes are drawn in so that their final judgment may be rendered.
tagGDX2Class09SkillDescription03B: Judged foes find their wills broken, their fates already sealed.
tagGDX2Class09SkillDescription03C: Rendering judgment fills your heart with fiery purpose which burns nearby foes.
tagGDX2Class09SkillDescription04A: First recorded in Arkovian texts when Agavold the Stalwart of the Temple of Vire selflessly charged through an entire legion of enemy forces, scattering their ranks and exposing them to an onslaught of arrows, all without taking a scratch. Vire's Might has since become a prime display of an Oathkeeper's strength, both physical and spiritual, in the face of seemingly impossible odds. When used with a shield, the shield's damage is added.
tagGDX2Class09SkillDescription04B: With fire in your heart and a prayer to Vire on your lips, your valiant charge leaves behind volcanic flames to incinerate your foes.
tagGDX2Class09SkillDescription04C: You charge forth with the might of the earth, traveling further and inflicting even greater lasting harm.
tagGDX2Class09SkillDescription04D: When struck with an Oathkeeper's shield, the burning vengeance of Vire's Might knocks less resolute foes off their feet. Requires a shield or two-handed melee weapon.
tagGDX2Class09SkillDescription05A: Oathkeepers are paragons of virtue and faith, properties they inspire within nearby allies. Those that stand beside them cannot help but be inspired into feats of valor.
tagGDX2Class09SkillDescription05B: The Oathkeeper's presence becomes a haven on the battlefield, offering solace from relentless blows.
tagGDX2Class09SkillDescription05C: The hearts of the Oathkeeper and their allies are stoked with righteous fury.
tagGDX2Class09SkillDescription06A: Through deep contemplation and resolute faith, an Oathkeeper may experience, even if briefly, a fragment of their deity's presence within them. This guiding light offers solace in trying times, a taste of a god's true might.
tagGDX2Class09SkillDescription06B: Driven to destroy their foes without hesitation, an Oathkeeper becomes the embodiment of celestial fury.
tagGDX2Class09SkillDescription07A: When the first Oathkeepers looked upon the celestial vale and witnessed the astounding power of Empyrion's light, they sought to replicate its brilliance and might. The culmination of their prayers and training was the Eye of Reckoning, a devastating display of martial combat that rapidly cleaves through all nearby foes in a whirlwind of fire and light for as long as the Oathkeeper channels their focus into the attack. Requires a melee weapon. At 100% Attack Speed, Eye of Reckoning deals damage and drains Energy every 0.16s.
tagGDX2Class09SkillDescription07B: Through the righteous fire burning with the Oathkeeper's soul, the light becomes as if a physical force, spiraling outward and piercing through unwary foes during the Eye of Reckoning.
tagGDX2Class09SkillDescription08A: Call forth a loyal servant of Empyrion to cleave through your foes and render celestial judgment. The Celestial Guardian scales with player bonuses.
tagGDX2Class09SkillDescription08B: The guardian's very presence sears the souls of your heretical foes.
tagGDX2Class09SkillDescription08C: Tainted by the gaze of Dreeg, the Celestial Guardian becomes a scion of acid and decay, a mirror of the deity it now serves.
tagGDX2Class09SkillDescription09A: Not all Oathkeepers swear fealty to deities blessing the Erulan empire. Some offer themselves before the three Witch Gods in the hopes of harnessing even a fraction of their terrible powers. These Oathkeepers consider themselves to be upon the true path, not deceived by empty promises of a light that has forsaken humanity.
tagGDX2Class09SkillDescription10A: Whether raising their shield in the name of Empyrion himself, or serving under the banners of a member of his celestial court, Oathkeepers that have risen in the ranks are considered to be an extension of divine will and heralds of celestial retribution.
tagGDX2Class09SkillDescription11A: In the hands of a trained Oathkeeper, a shield is not just an unbreakable defense, but also a formidable weapon. This is a shield bonus.
tagGDX2Class09SkillDescription12A: A precise strike fueled by the Oathkeeper's righteous fury leaves enemies staggered and broken. With sufficient practice, this technique can even be extended to a shield. Can activate with all default weapon attacks. When used with a melee weapon and shield, will also strike with the shield.
tagGDX2Class09SkillDescription13A: Such is an Oathkeeper's prowess with a shield that the force of the blow resonates through the earth and sends an additional shockwave through your initial target. This is a shield combat technique that activates off of default weapon attacks. Requires a melee weapon and shield.
tagGDX2Class09SkillDescription14A: For an Oathkeeper, resolute faith is the absolute defense. As life fades, so the spirit rises to oppose further harm.
tagGDX2DevotionEffectB201Desc: The decree of Korvaak's Herald fills you with stone focus and determination.
tagGDX2DevotionEffectB202Desc: The blinding glare of the celestial guardian falls upon your foes, sowing confusion among their ranks.
tagGDX2DevotionEffectC201Desc: The eldritch gaze of Korvaak falls upon you in an expanding ring, piercing through any foes unfortunate enough to be in the way.
tagGDX2DevotionEffectC202Desc: The sands of Azrakaa ebb and flow across the battlefield, piercing through foes before returning to your position.
tagGDX2DevotionEffectC203Desc: The black blood of Yugol spills from your wounds, festering upon the battlefield and seeking out foes to consume within its eternal darkness.
tagGDX2Devotion_A201Desc: The nighttalon is an elusive and agile hunter, stalking the night sky for easy prey.
tagGDX2Devotion_A202Desc: The mantis hungrily tears at the celestial tapestry, eager for wallowing stars to devour.
tagGDX2Devotion_A203Desc: The scarab scurries across the night sky, seeking Azrakaa's sands to burrow into.
tagGDX2Devotion_A204Desc: A celestial omen of good fortune. Those born under its light are said to have lives of peace and happiness.
tagGDX2Devotion_B201Desc: A titan loyal only to Korvaak, Ulzaad heralded the arrival of his patron to all his subjects. Without his master's command, Ulzaad became disillusioned and lost, eventually driven to madness and despair.
tagGDX2Devotion_B202: Hyrian, Guardian of the Celestial Gates
tagGDX2Devotion_B202Desc: Hyrian is the immortal creation of Targo the Builder, created millennia ago to stand eternal vigil over the celestial tapestry the primordial gods inhabit.
tagGDX2Devotion_C201Desc: The Eldritch Sun rises once again to claim its celestial throne.
tagGDX2Devotion_C202Desc: Azrakaa, the eternal companion of Aeon, crafts the very sands with which the keeper of time decides the fates of mortals. She is his consort, and most trusted advisor, often tempering Aeon's harsh judgment and offering solace to the mortals she cherishes.
tagGDX2Devotion_C203Desc: When Empyrion's light first spread beyond creation, the gods discovered that a great darkness sweltered within the nothingness. It had but one name: Yugol. Yugol's insatiable hunger threatens to consume all that the primordials had painstakingly crafted, its advance thwarted only by the merciful light of a thousand-thousand stars.

tagGDX3Boss_KurnChieftain: Chieftain Gruldir of the Dread Wastes
tagGDX3Class10SkillDescription01A: Kurn berserkers blessed with Mogdrogen's gift were some of the most terrifying troops fielded in their ancient war with Erulan. To this day, tales of these warriors paint the Kurn as savage bloodthirsty monsters. With Mogdrogen's gift, you assume the form of the werewolf, gaining new bonuses and abilities for as long as the transformation persists. Werewolf form cannot use default weapon attacks or weapon pool skills.
tagGDX3Class10SkillDescription01B: Your voracious lupine hunger can only be sated by the precious vitality of your enemies. Modifies Feral Claws while in Werewolf form.
tagGDX3Class10SkillDescription01C: You tear at your foes with reckless abandon, extending your lupine rampage with every critical blow.
tagGDX3Class10SkillDescription01D: The corrupted blood of Ch'thon has taken hold within you, twisting your transformation into a ravenous abomination bent on destruction.
tagGDX3Class10SkillDescription02A: Kurn mystics are known to take on the aspect of dread ravens to terrorize the enemy with their talons and ice magic. Through Mogdrogen's guidance and blessing, you too can assume the form of the wereraven, gaining new bonuses and abilities for as long as the transformation persists. Wereraven form cannot use default weapon attacks or weapon pool skills.
tagGDX3Class10SkillDescription02B: Your icy talons are imbued with the glaciers of Asterkarn, giving them longer reach and a lasting chill. Modifies Ice Talons while in Wereraven form.
tagGDX3Class10SkillDescription02C: You exert complete control over the icy chill of Asterkarn, greatly enhancing the chilling effects of your abilities while transformed into a Wereraven.
tagGDX3Class10SkillDescription02D: Dipped within the tainted blood of Ch'thon, your raven talons tear through reality itself, sending ripples through the cosmos.
tagGDX3Class10SkillDescription03A: Kurn berserkers would lull their enemies into a false sense of confidence by engaging in a series of feints before unleashing a devastating well-timed blow. When used as your default weapon attack, Onslaught generates stacks. Your next activated cooldown attack will consume all stacks to deal additional damage.
tagGDX3Class10SkillDescription03B: Your onslaught wears down your foes with countless grievous wounds.
tagGDX3Class10SkillDescription03C: You extend your onslaught, building ever more rage before unleashing it upon your foes.
tagGDX3Class10SkillDescription03D: You brand your weapons with the sigils of Ch'thon, funneling your rage into grisly blows that echo with the power of the void.
tagGDX3Class10SkillDescription04A: Ever the first into the fray, you leap with such ferocity that the very earth shatters upon your arrival.
tagGDX3Class10SkillDescription04B: You leap with such ferocity that the resulting shockwave sends ripples through the very earth. The fault lines initially deal 25% reduced damage before reaching their full strength as they expand outward.
tagGDX3Class10SkillDescription05A: You unleash a boisterous battle cry that reinvigorates you and your allies and rallies them back into the fray.
tagGDX3Class10SkillDescription05B: Your rallying cry triggers a rush of adrenaline that leaves you feeling unstoppable.
tagGDX3Class10SkillDescription05C: Kurn berserkers are an unquenchable force of destruction upon the field of battle. Their battle cries drown out the sounds of carnage. When embracing the path of the frenzied berserker, Rallying Cry can be used more frequently. This is a melee and ranged dual-wielding technique. Also enables the ability to dual wield melee and ranged weapons.
tagGDX3Class10SkillDescription06A: The Kurn are spiritual people, believing their fates to be firmly tied to the will of their gods. Chief among them is Amatok, the Spirit of Winter. Without his mercy, none would survive Asterkarn's brutal winters. You form a pact with Amatok, granting his blessing to you and nearby allies.
tagGDX3Class10SkillDescription06B: Amatok's bond stokes the fury and bloodthirst in your hearts.
tagGDX3Class10SkillDescription06C: Your bond with Amatok deepens, infusing you with winter's chill and hardening your body against maladies.
tagGDX3Class10SkillDescription07A: The chill in the Asterkarn peaks is legendary. Some have come to call the wind the reaper's caress, but to the Kurn it is Amatok's Breath. Their mystics have learned to channel its fury. For as long as the spell is maintained, the bitter winds of Asterkarn will assail your foes and tear flesh from bone. At 100% Cast Speed, Winds of Asterkarn deals damage and drains Energy every 0.16s and grows in size every 0.48s until it reaches maximum size.
tagGDX3Class10SkillDescription07B: As the winds howl around you, icy hail forms and descends upon your foes.
tagGDX3Class10SkillDescription08A: Those that have embraced the chill of Asterkarn in their hearts are forever changed by the ordeal. They brave Cairn's dangers knowing that Amatok walks with them.
tagGDX3Class10SkillDescription09A: Those that give in completely to their primal impulses discover newfound might and sharpened senses. Only the release of death can stop a warrior in such a state of mind.
tagGDX3Class10SkillDescription10A: To a trained berserker, there is no greater thrill than the glory of combat. As you land critical blows, you feel invigorated.
tagGDX3Class10SkillDescription11A: A wild beast is most dangerous when cornered, so too is a wounded berserker. As harm comes to you, it only deepens your rage.
tagGDX3Class10SkillDescription12A: Berserkers that submit wholly to the transformation risk losing themselves to the beast within, but find that they can tap into primal strength that goes beyond their mortal limits. [Bonuses active while in Werewolf or Wereraven form and requires one to unlock]
tagGDX3Class10SkillDescription13A: Kurn berserkers have honed the art of two-weapon combat to deadly perfection. Their weapons are not just tools, but an extension of their relentless onslaught. This is a dual weapon bonus. Also enables the ability to dual wield weapons.
tagGDX3Class10SkillDescription14A: A cruel double strike leaves your enemies bleeding out. Can activate with all default weapon attacks.
tagGDX3Class10SkillDescription15A: You harness the might of Amatok in your attack, sending an avalanche of crushing ice with your attack. Can activate with all default weapon attacks.
tagGDX3Class10SkillDescription16A: You unleash a bloodcurdling battle cry that shatters enemy defenses and leaves your foes demoralized and broken.
tagGDX3Class10SkillWereravenAbilityDescr: You conjure vicious ice talons to tear through enemies in front of you.
You slam your talons into the ground, unleashing a cascade of ice. The ice initially deals 25% reduced damage before reaching its full strength as it expands outward.
tagGDX3Class10SkillWerewolfAbilityDescri: You swipe at your foes with savage claws, cutting through their ranks.
You rip and tear through your foes in a straight line, tossing the weak aside as the fodder they are.
